correctness.rationale: Following e_i^2=a_i e_sigma(i), idempotence restricts each permutation cycle to x_{i0}^{2^ell-1}=A_C^{-1}. The last weight enters A_C to first power, so independent uniform nonzero weights make each A_C uniform in F_q^*, and a cycle contributes Y=1+d_ell with chance 1/d_ell, else 1, d_ell=gcd(2^ell-1,q-1). Multiplication over cycles and the classical symmetric-group cycle index prove exact finite distribution and all complex moments because counts are positive and bounded. For q=4 odd cycles always contribute two, even cycles contribute one or four, yielding the q=4 H_n GF, (1/3)_m/m! zero-only law and second-moment (1-z)^-5(1+z)^-1 with variance n^4/48+O(n^3). Independent q4 and n2 mean arithmetic crosscheck is consistent; infinite proof is algebraic.
